column1: Whisk the soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger together.
Put the salmon in a bag or shallow dish, pour roughly half the mixture over it, turn to coat, and refrigerate 15 minutes to 4 hours.
Preheat the oven to 375°F (191°C) and line a baking sheet with foil, parchment, or a silicone mat.
Place the salmon skin side down on the sheet and bake 15–20 minutes until it reaches 145°F (63°C) in the thickest part. Broil for the last minute for crispier edges if desired.
While the salmon bakes, bring the reserved marinade to a boil in a small saucepan, then simmer on medium-low 3–4 minutes until slightly thickened, watching closely so it doesn't burn.
Drizzle the glaze over the salmon and garnish as desired.
